runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Fresh diversified sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Praca za rohom, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress public ecosystem, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. Upwork exposed several WooCommerce results, but none cleared the combined freshness, economics, competition and skill-fit bar for LIVE promotion. A fresh WordPress developer role posted yesterday requires native English, US business hours and stronger hard-development skills, so it was rejected for profile mismatch. Facebook has 0 verified hits. Existing LIVE jobs remain fail-closed because jobs-data.json is truncated by the repository reader and complete round-trip replacement cannot be guaranteed.

developmentChanges.title: Remote timezone compatibility gate
developmentChanges.reason: Treat mandatory foreign business-hour overlap as a separate remote feasibility signal. Remote roles that technically allow Slovakia but require sustained US/night hours should be downgraded or rejected before application time is spent.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance client recency score
developmentChanges.reason: Combine last client view, interviewing count, hires and proposal volume so stale or already-filled freelance posts stop outranking actively reviewed opportunities.
